name_en: Miso Poteto — deep-fried battered potato glazed with sweet miso sauce
summary_ja: ゆでたじゃがいもに衣をつけて揚げ、甘辛い味噌だれを絡めた秩父地方の一品。いろりで焼いたじゃがいもに味噌を塗った素朴な始まりが、2009年のB級グルメ大会優勝で全国区に。
summary_en: Boiled potato coated in batter, deep-fried and glazed with a sweet-savory miso sauce, from the Chichibu area. It began simply as hearth-roasted potato brushed with miso, then went national after winning a 2009 local-food contest.
source_title: みそポテト｜うちの郷土料理｜農林水産省
